tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.subtitle: Please review all terms before requesting a commission.

tos01.title: Commission Acceptance
tos01.content: Submitting a commission request does not guarantee acceptance. I reserve the right to accept or decline any commission.

tos02.title: Commission Scope
tos02.content: The final price, included features, deliverables, revisions, and estimated completion time will be agreed upon before work begins. Requests outside the agreed scope may require an additional fee.

tos03.title: Payment
tos03.content: All commissions use a 50/50 payment structure: 50% upfront before work begins. 50% remaining balance before final delivery. I will not begin work until the initial payment has been received.

tos04.title: Payment Methods
tos04.content: Available payment methods will be confirmed during the commission process. Payment processing fees or currency conversion fees may apply depending on the selected platform.

tos05.title: Quotes
tos05.content: Displayed prices are base prices. The final quote may change depending on character complexity, additional features, commercial use, deadline, or other requested work.

tos06.title: Revisions
tos06.content: Revisions are limited to the amount and stages agreed upon for the commission. Minor changes within the agreed scope are included. Major changes, redesigns, or requests that require previously approved work to be substantially redone may incur an additional fee.

tos07.title: Approval of Work
tos07.content: Once a stage has been approved, I may proceed to the next stage. Changes requested after approval may be treated as additional revisions and may incur additional costs.

tos08.title: Refunds
tos08.content: Once the agreed sketch stage has been completed and approved, payments are non-refundable. If a cancellation is requested before that point, any possible refund will depend on the amount of work already completed and will be discussed individually.

tos09.title: Cancellation
tos09.content: Either party may request cancellation. If the client cancels after work has begun, payment for completed work is non-refundable. If I must cancel the commission, I will communicate the situation and provide an appropriate refund for work that has not been completed.

tos10.title: Deadlines
tos10.content: Delivery dates are estimates unless a specific deadline has been explicitly agreed upon. Completion times may change due to project complexity, revisions, workload, client response time, or unforeseen circumstances.

tos11.title: Urgent Commissions
tos11.content: Urgent commissions may be accepted depending on availability. An additional fee may apply.

tos12.title: Client Responsibilities
tos12.content: The client is responsible for providing accurate references, files, instructions, feedback, and approvals necessary to complete the commission.

tos13.title: Client Delays
tos13.content: Delays caused by missing information, files, feedback, or approvals from the client may extend the estimated delivery time. Extended periods without communication may result in the commission being paused.

tos14.title: Additional Work
tos14.content: Requests that were not included in the original commission scope may be quoted separately before the additional work begins.

tos15.title: Commercial Use
tos15.content: The intended use of the commissioned work must be disclosed during the commission process. Commercial-use rights and any additional licensing fees will be agreed upon before work begins.

tos16.title: Copyright
tos16.content: I retain authorship and copyright of my original artwork and Rigging work unless a separate written agreement states otherwise. Purchasing a commission does not constitute a transfer of copyright ownership.

tos17.title: Client Usage Rights
tos17.content: The client receives the usage rights agreed upon for their commission. Unless explicitly agreed otherwise, the client may not resell, redistribute, claim authorship of, or transfer the original commissioned files as their own work.

tos18.title: Portfolio Rights
tos18.content: Unless a private commission has been agreed upon beforehand, I may display completed work and appropriate work-in-progress material in my: Portfolio, Website, Social media, YouTube, Promotional material.

tos19.title: Private Commissions
tos19.content: If the client requires the commission to remain private, this must be discussed and agreed upon before the commission begins. Additional fees may apply depending on the circumstances.

tos20.title: Artist Credit
tos20.content: Clients are encouraged to credit me when publicly displaying the commissioned work. Any specific credit requirements will be communicated during the commission process.

tos21.title: AI Policy
tos21.content: My commissioned artwork, PSD files, Rigging files, and other original work may not be used for: AI training, Dataset creation, Machine-learning training, AI image generation, AI model development, Similar AI-related purposes unless I have given explicit written permission.

tos22.title: Chargebacks & Payment Disputes
tos22.content: Clients should contact me directly to resolve payment or commission issues before initiating a chargeback or payment dispute. Unauthorized chargebacks may be contested using the available commission records, payment records, and agreed Terms of Service.

tos23.title: File Delivery
tos23.content: Final files will be delivered digitally through the agreed delivery method. The client is responsible for downloading and securely storing their files after delivery.

tos24.title: File Storage
tos24.content: I may not permanently retain completed commission files indefinitely. Clients are responsible for maintaining their own backups of delivered files.

tos25.title: Technical Limitations
tos25.content: The final result may be affected by technical limitations, client-provided files, software limitations, or requirements outside the agreed scope. Any significant technical limitation discovered during the project will be communicated to the client.

tos26.title: Third-Party Software
tos26.content: The functionality of commissioned models may depend on third-party software such as VTube Studio or Live2D Cubism. I cannot guarantee permanent compatibility with future versions or changes made by third-party software developers.

tos27.title: Agreement
tos27.content: By proceeding with payment, the client confirms that they have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms of Service. Any exception or modification to these terms must be agreed upon in writing before the relevant work begins.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about commissions and services.

faq01.question: What services do you offer?
faq01.answer: I offer VTuber Art + PSD Preparation, Live2D Rigging, and a Full Model package combining both services.

faq02.question: Can I commission only the artwork?
faq02.answer: Yes. The Art + PSD Preparation service includes the illustration and a layered PSD prepared specifically for Live2D Rigging.

faq03.question: Can I commission only the Rigging?
faq03.answer: Yes. You can provide your own Live2D-ready PSD and commission me for the Rigging only. I will review the PSD before confirming the final price.

faq04.question: Do you accept existing PSD files for Rigging?
faq04.answer: Yes, as long as the PSD is properly separated and contains the necessary layers for Rigging. I will review your file before accepting the commission. Additional separation or art fixes may require an extra fee.

faq05.question: What is included in your Rigging?
faq05.answer: My Rigging is offered as one package, with the included features listed in the Rigging section of my portfolio. Additional or more complex features may require an extra fee.

faq06.question: How much does a commission cost?
faq06.answer: Prices depend on the body size, service, and complexity of the model. You can find the starting prices in the Commissions section. For more complex designs, I will provide a final quote after reviewing your references.

faq07.question: How does the payment work?
faq07.answer: I use a 50/50 payment system. The first 50% is required before I begin working, and the remaining 50% must be paid before the final files are delivered.

faq08.question: Can I request changes during the commission?
faq08.answer: Yes. You will have opportunities to review the work during the process. The number and type of revisions included depend on the stage and service. Major changes requested after approval may require an additional fee.

faq09.question: How long does a commission take?
faq09.answer: The delivery time depends on the complexity of the model, the selected service, and the current commission queue. I will provide an estimated timeframe when your commission is confirmed.

faq10.question: Do you accept commercial use?
faq10.answer: Yes. Commercial use is available according to my Terms of Service. Please mention your intended use when submitting your commission request so I can include it in the quote if necessary.

faq11.question: Can I use the model for streaming and monetized content?
faq11.answer: Yes, provided that your commission includes the appropriate commercial-use rights. Please specify your intended use when requesting a commission.

faq12.question: Can I request an urgent commission?
faq12.answer: Urgent commissions may be accepted depending on my current workload. An additional fee may apply. Please contact me with your deadline before placing a request.

faq13.question: What happens if I need to cancel my commission?
faq13.answer: Cancellation and refund conditions depend on how far the commission has progressed. Please read my Terms of Service before commissioning.

faq14.question: Can you keep my commission private?
faq14.answer: Yes, if you offer a private commission option. This should be explicitly agreed upon before work begins, as otherwise completed work may be used in my portfolio and promotional content.

faq15.question: What files will I receive?
faq15.answer: For Art + PSD Preparation, you will receive the final artwork and the layered PSD prepared for Live2D. For Rigging, you will receive the completed Rigging files and the files necessary for use in the agreed setup.

faq16.question: Will you help me set up the model in VTube Studio?
faq16.answer: I can provide basic guidance for importing and using the model in VTube Studio. Full technical troubleshooting outside the delivered model may not be included.

faq17.question: How do I request a commission?
faq17.answer: Use the Request a Commission button and fill out the commission form with your character references, desired service, deadline, budget, and other relevant information. I will review your request and contact you with the next steps.
